mapper.select: SELECT IMAGE_NO, PRODUCT_NO, OPTION_ID, IMAGE_PURPOSE, IMAGE_ORDER, IMAGE_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} ORDER BY OPTION_ID, CASE WHEN IMAGE_PURPOSE = '대표' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, IMAGE_ORDER, IMAGE_NO
